service.description: Finds an id (any spelling: #GOR123, gor123, a Shopify gid) in the active tenant's ID index with one read, then follows the records it belongs to through the values they share (a HotWax order to its Shopify order, a NetSuite sales order to its fulfillments) up to 4 hops and 200 records. Identifiers only: no customer details or order contents.

parameter.name: value
parameter.description: The id as the person gave it.

parameter.name: search
parameter.description: {value, idNorm, records: [{systemCode, systemEnumId, connectionId, recordKind, recordKey, ids: [{fieldPath, idRaw, role}], foundBy, indexedAt}], capped, cappedReason}

service.description: How current the active tenant's ID index is: one row per kept copy of a system it reads (indexed or behind, last indexed, last failure), and the tenant's row count. Runs' own extracts are indexed as they finish.

parameter.name: connections
parameter.description: [{datasetId, connectionId, systemEnumId, lastReadAt, lastIndexedAt, rowsLastPass, lastStatus, lastError, behind, stale}]

service.description: Adds a tenant ID field, or overrides a product field with the same fieldId (blank fields keep the product's). The system must be one the index reads; a new field needs a path and a role. A path must be plain (name.name, lists as name[*]); one that looks like a customer detail (email, phone, address, names ...) is refused: the index keeps identifiers only.

if.condition: !darpan.facade.common.TenantAccessSupport.requireActiveTenantWriteAccess(ec, 'Your active tenant only has view access for the ID index.')

set.from: darpan.idindex.IdIndexCatalog.tenantFieldRefusal(ec, [systemEnumId: systemEnumId, fieldId: fieldId, fieldPath: fieldPath, role: role, isActive: isActive])

service-call.name: store#darpan.idindex.TenantIdIndexField
service-call.in-map: [companyUserGroupId: tenantId, systemEnumId: systemEnumId, fieldId: fieldId, recordKind: recordKind, fieldPath: fieldPath, role: role, refRecordKind: refRecordKind, isActive: isActive, description: description, lastChangedByUserId: ec.user.userId]

service.description: Removes the tenant's own ID field or its override (the product field, if any, applies again). The system's kept copies are indexed again by the nightly catch-up.

if.condition: !darpan.facade.common.TenantAccessSupport.requireActiveTenantWriteAccess(ec, 'Your active tenant only has view access for the ID index.')
